name: Kūkai Ramen
recommendation: Japanese-style ramen shop open for lunch and dinner, with no-frills bar seating and plastic crates under the chair for your jacket. The food options are few and very tasty. Have a traditional pork ramen or a vegan version, and try the gyōza or a few other appetizers. The space is tiny, so on cold days there may be a wait outside since there are no reservations. The wait is worth it.
